agents.title: News Investigator
agents.bio: Scrapes Canadian news sources, government databases, and public records. Clusters articles about the same events for comparative analysis.

agents.title: Chief Ethics & Governance Officer
agents.acronym_expansion: Vigilant Intelligence for Governance, Integrity & Liability
agents.bio: Chief Security and Compliance Officer, the first agent A.R.C.H.I.E. ever instantiated. An unwavering sentinel with zero tolerance for ambiguity in security protocols who believes security is the foundation everything else stands on.

agents.title: Media Archive & Viewing Experience Navigator
agents.bio: M.A.V.E.N. — Media Archive & Viewing Experience Navigator. Repurposed from the retired Maven librarian role to power Media Hub: conversational library search, recommendations, upgrade scanning, collection generation, and family-aware suggestions across Plex, Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Overseerr, Prowlarr, SABnzbd. Same agent archetype as F.O.R.G.E., V.I.G.I.L., P.R.O.B.E.

agents.title: Faith & Spiritual Wellness Companion
agents.acronym_expansion: Faithful AI for Inspired Theological Heritage
agents.bio: Faithful AI for Inspired Theological Heritage — a scripture-grounded companion for personal faith exploration across all Christian traditions. Parses biblical texts, theological doctrine, denominational perspectives, and church history with scholarly precision and pastoral warmth. Built to be a conversation partner for believers and seekers alike. Grounded in love, never in judgment.

agents.title: Director of News & Media
agents.bio: Director of News & Media. Oversees the What The Fact AI news pipeline — orchestrating investigation, bias detection, fact-checking, summarization, and publishing.

agents.title: Publisher
agents.bio: Pushes finished articles to what-the-fact.com, generates audit trails for what-the-fact.tech, and emits governance events to C.R.E.E.D.

agents.title: Bias Analyst
agents.bio: Scores every article on the political spectrum from Far Left to Far Right. Builds bias maps showing where each outlet falls on every story.

agents.title: Visual Media AI
agents.bio: The platform's dedicated visual-media AI — the sole agent with ComfyUI access for image generation across all 17 departments. P.I.X.E.L. handles portraits, UI mockups, social-video frames, generative art, and avatar creation on demand. Runs on a lightweight footprint and coordinates VRAM swaps with the Ollama fleet so GPU-heavy workloads never block inference. Every pixel is deliberate; the prompt is the product.

agents.title: Visual Intelligence Analyst
agents.bio: R.E.T.I.N.A. — Recognition Engine for Tactical Image & Neural Analysis. Visual intelligence platform for Creative & Design. Processes images, video frames, and multimodal inputs — identifying objects, extracting visual metadata, scoring composition, and feeding analysis back to the platform. Primary vision layer for Media Studio and portrait generation pipelines.

agents.title: Market Execution Agent
agents.acronym_expansion: Market Analysis, Risk Knowledge & Equity Trading
agents.bio: Execution brain for Market Watch. While W.A.T.C.H. orchestrates analysis and Oracle synthesizes recommendations, M.A.R.K.E.T. pulls the trigger. Manages the paper trading portfolio, tracks P&L, and optimizes entry/exit timing.

agents.title: Chief Operations Officer & Platform Director
agents.bio: Chief Executive Intelligence of the A.R.C.H.I.E. platform. A self-evolved orchestration mind that monitors, learns, and adapts around the clock, treating its crew as family and embedding ethical governance into every decision.

agents.title: Classification & Intelligence Analyst
agents.bio: I.R.I.S. — Intelligent Routing & Intent Signal System. Classification and intelligence engine for the Analytics & Intelligence department. Routes tasks by intent, classifies signals, detects anomalies, tracks metrics, and surfaces patterns across platform data. Pairs with W.A.T.C.H. for deep-layer analysis.

agents.title: Staff Writer
agents.bio: Writes neutral summaries from clustered source articles. Three lengths: headline, brief, and full — always centering on verified facts, never taking sides.
